messages:
Jamie (Support): FYI — ACME (acct: acme-enterprise) flagged invoice INV-2026-03-ACME-47. Invoice shows 3,412,982 tokens billed but the Usage dashboard export shows 2,097,401. Customer asking for a breakdown and a credit.
Ashok K.: Can you paste the invoice ID + any request IDs they have? Also which model/version were they hitting?
Jamie (Support): Invoice INV-2026-03-ACME-47. Customer provided request ids: req_01F3Y6A9, req_01F3Z1B2. They attached a CSV export (internal link). They say the discrepancy started Mar 20 and spans ~1 week.
Sam (SRE): I'll query the metering pipeline. Historically we've seen streaming reconnects double-count partial chunks. Pulling logs now. Which model did they use?
Jamie (Support): App logs show model: gpt-4-redwood-2, streaming via SSE with client reconnects enabled.
Ashok K.: Reproducer snippet: 
````bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"model":"gpt-4-redwood-2","stream":true,"input":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# interrupt client, then resume within ~10s
````
We had a known bug where partial-stream chunk token counts could be persisted twice. See internal PR internal/PR-2345.
Sam (SRE): Confirmed. Metering emitted two events for the same stream session when the client rejoined within 15s. Querying account aggregates shows ~1,315,581 extra tokens for acme-enterprise between 2026-03-20 and 2026-03-27. Root cause: stream-session dedupe window misconfigured after rollout.
Jamie (Support): Ok finance needs exact adjustment to propose credit. @Maria G. can you advise required fields?
Maria G.: For the credit memo and revrec note we need: 1) token delta + USD amount, 2) affected invoice line, 3) suggested journal entry (GLs), 4) short customer-facing explanation for the memo.
Sam (SRE): Tokens delta = 1,315,581 tokens. Using invoice tier pricing $0.00008/token -> USD = 1,315,581 * 0.00008 = 105.24648 => round to $105.25. Affected invoice line: INV-2026-03-ACME-47 line: "Usage - GPT generation". Cause: duplicate streaming events (MET-STREAM-23). Patch and backfill in progress.
Ashok K.: Patch: tighten dedupe window to 1s + idempotency token check. Deployed 2026-03-30 03:12 UTC. Backfill job id: backfill-2026-03-30-01 (running).
Jamie (Support): Customer asked for immediate credit rather than waiting for corrected invoice. They accept $105.25 credit + short note.
Maria G.: I'll create credit memo and revrec note. Draft revrec: "Adjustment due to metering duplicate-counting bug MET-STREAM-23 affecting acct acme-enterprise; credit issued $105.25; reverse revenue recognized 03/30/2026; GL suggestion: Debit 4002 (Revenue) -> Credit 2310 (Customer Credits). Reference support case SC-78912."
Billing Bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-031-ACME-1 for $105.25 against INV-2026-03-ACME-47. Status: pending approval.
Jamie (Support): Draft customer message: "We're sorry — we discovered a metering issue causing duplicated token counts on some streaming sessions between Mar 20–27. We've issued a $105.25 credit to your account (CM-2026-031-ACME-1) and fixed the bug. If you'd like the invoice reissued, we can do that." @Maria G. please review.
Maria G.: Approved. Send to customer and mark case resolved after acknowledgement. I'll record revrec note in finance system.
Sam (SRE): Adding alert: trigger if invoice vs dashboard delta >5% per-customer for monthly invoices. Will monitor backfill and confirm corrected aggregates.
Jamie (Support): Sending update to ACME now. Closing loop here — will post final backfill confirmation when job completes. :white_check_mark:
